summary: The first mismatch is at step 67, when the thrown polymorph potion should resume into potion.c potionhit() and call bhitm() on the orc. The JavaScript POT_POLYMORPH arm records note_unported() and skips the already implemented zap.c bhitm() polymorph behavior; the immediate actionable scope is the whole potionhit() source function and its production callers, while preserving unrelated named gaps.

source.branch: In potionhit(), when a potion hits a non-hero monster, the saddle-hit arm was not selected, and obj->otyp is POT_POLYMORPH, the effect switch calls (void) bhitm(mon, obj). The recorded hostile orc takes the ordinary head-hit path. bhitm() then runs its polymorph arm: skip a long worm already changed by this ray; honor magic resistance; call resist() with zero damage; then either apply the natural-form system-shock roll or call newcham(), followed by the function common tail.
callers: Recorded route: cmd.c command dispatch reaches dothrow.c dothrow(), throwit(), throwit_mon_hit(), and thitmonst(); thitmonst() calls potionhit(mon, obj, POTHIT_HERO_THROW) at dothrow.c:2264. Production JS routes the t command through js/cmd.js to js/dothrow.js dothrow(), throwit(), throwit_mon_hit(), and thitmonst(), which calls js/potion.js potionhit() at js/dothrow.js:3092.
Other dothrow.c callers are toss_up() at :1290 when a thrown potion hits the hero and throwit() at :1594 when it hits the steed; JS counterparts in js/dothrow.js call potionhit() at :1231 and :2591.
Monster missile callers are mthrowu.c at :137, :367, and :699; JS counterparts in js/mthrowu.js call potionhit() for a monster projectile hitting the hero or another monster.
uhitm.c hmon_hitmon_potion() calls potionhit() at :1105; js/uhitm.js hmon_hitmon_potion() calls the same production JS entry point at :2959.
dependencies: zap.c bhitm() at :160-610 owns the immediate polymorph mechanics. Its POT_POLYMORPH arm at :265-334 is already present in js/zap.js bhitm() at :4075-4144. Wire potionhit() to that implementation with the current state, random source, and operation environment. C casts away bhitm()'s int return, so use only its effects and do not make the result control potionhit().

zap.c resist() at :6100-6158 is already implemented in js/zap.js. The potion class attack level is 6; the orc defense level in this recording yields the logged first draw rn2(105) at resist(zap.c:6141). It is reached only after potionhit() calls bhitm().

mon.c newcham(), select_newcham_form(), and mgender_from_permonst() are implemented in js/mon.js. Their logged draws rn2(330), rn2(10), and d(11,8) follow the resistance and bhitm() natural-form roll in the C recording.

Keep potionhit()'s common continuation after bhitm() in source order: target waking, the hero-distance vapor/calling decision, shop billing, and final obfree(). potionbreathe() is a separate function and is not the owner of this first mismatch.

The immutable recording challenges/cases/v16/rogue-throws-polymorph-potion-at-orc.session.json shows step 66 key h ending at “The jar crashes on the orc's head and breaks into shards.--More--”, after thitmonst() and potionhit() have logged rn2(7) in bottlename() and rn2(5) at potion.c:1675. At step 67, C resumes into the polymorph effect and logs rn2(105)=56 at resist(zap.c:6141), rn2(25)=9 at bhitm(zap.c:290), rn2(330)=136 at select_newcham_form(mon.c:5217), rn2(10)=7 at mgender_from_permonst(mon.c:5269), and d(11,8)=57 at newmonhp(makemon.c:1042). The resulting screen says the magenta potion evaporates and the orc turns into a baby red dragon, followed by another --More--.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c potionhit() spans :1625-1928. In its non-hero, non-saddle effect switch, :1885-1887 calls (void) bhitm(mon, obj) for POT_POLYMORPH. This is the missing source call; the queue labels the first missing random draw by the downstream resist() function.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c bhitm() :265-334 handles WAN_POLYMORPH, SPE_POLYMORPH, and POT_POLYMORPH. For a potion polyspot is false; the branch preserves long-worm and magic-resistance checks, consumes resist(), applies the natural-form rn2(25) system-shock check, or calls newcham(). Existing js/zap.js bhitm() has this branch, but js/potion.js potionhit() :2468-2472 currently calls note_unported('zap.c bhitm potion polymorph') instead of invoking it.

That skip explains the displaced next JS RNG call: after the note_unported() no-op, js/potion.js continues into potionhit()'s hero-distance vapor/calling tail at :2499-2509, where its next recorded draw is rn2(9). C has not reached that tail on step 67 because bhitm() has produced the polymorph continuation message and --More-- after its five logged draws.

Production caller evidence is dothrow.c thitmonst() :2264 and js/dothrow.js thitmonst() :3092. The recorded t, g, h, space inputs select the potion, throw west at the adjacent generated orc, show the crash screen, then resume the source effect. The same potionhit() function has additional production callers from dothrow.c toss_up()/throwit(), mthrowu.c monster throws, and uhitm.c hmon_hitmon_potion(); their JS counterparts already route to js/potion.js potionhit().
